<member name="M:Inno.Build.Cli.BuildApplication.Run(System.String[],System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Runs one build command without taking ownership of the caller's cancellation source.
    </summary>
    <param name="arguments">
    The command and its documented options; help prints the supported command names.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels owned work and preserves completed publications according to their pipeline contracts.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Zero on success, two on cancellation, or one on a command or execution failure.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentNullException">
    The argument array is absent.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="T:Inno.Build.Distribution.Standard.StandardBuildCaches">

    </summary>

<member name="M:Inno.Build.Distribution.Standard.StandardBuildCaches.CreateShaderWorkspaceAsync(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)">
    <summary>
    Creates a shader compilation workspace in the registered process-owned build cache.
    </summary>
    <param name="engineRoot">
    The checkout owning cache maintenance and the source-independent compiler request.
    </param>
    <param name="cancellationToken">
    Cancels registration or ownership acquisition before compilation begins.
    </param>
    <returns>
    A fresh directory lease; the caller must retain it until compilation finishes and dispose it afterward.
    Remaining claim metadata is retired by the same cache maintenance service.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.IOException">
    The cache boundary or operation ownership cannot be established.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.OperationCanceledException">
    The request was canceled before workspace ownership was returned.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    The checkout root is blank or relative.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Build.Distribution.Standard.StandardBuildCaches.CreateOwners(System.String,System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList{Inno.Build.Toolchains.NativeComponentDescriptor})">
    <summary>
    Registers exact Native, binding and Support Pack ownership recorded by their publishers.
    Unrecorded directories remain outside the cleanup authority.
    </summary>
    <param name="engineRoot">
    The absolute engine checkout containing the artifact roots.
    </param>
    <param name="components">
    The actual registered component owners; shared toolchain roots are registered once.
    </param>
    <returns>
    Immutable owner registrations with current-generation and transitive dependency protection.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.ArgumentException">
    The root is blank or relative.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Build.Distribution.Standard.StandardBuildEnvironment.Capture(System.String,Inno.Build.BuildTargetId,System.String)">
    <summary>
    Resolves the selected managed host and captures execution capabilities at the composition boundary.
    </summary>
    <param name="applicationDirectory">
    The product or tool's installed location used for source provisioning.
    </param>
    <param name="toolsTarget">
    The native target explicitly selected for executable build tools, independently of exported games.
    </param>
    <param name="dotnetHost">
    An explicit SDK executable, or null to use DOTNET_HOST_PATH, the loaded shared runtime's
    muxer, then normal executable discovery when this process has no shared runtime installation.
    </param>
    <returns>
    A frozen execution context; publication targets must be selected independently.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.PlatformNotSupportedException">
    The distribution has no build execution integration for this system or processor.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.FileNotFoundException">
    The selected managed SDK host cannot be located.
    </exception>
</member>

<member name="M:Inno.Build.Distribution.Standard.StandardBuildEnvironment.ResolveManagedHost(System.String)">
    <summary>
    Resolves the managed SDK executable without selecting a native tool target or preparing a product.
    </summary>
    <param name="dotnetHost">
    Explicit executable, or null to use DOTNET_HOST_PATH and then the currently loaded runtime's installation.
    Normal executable discovery is used only when there is no shared runtime installation.
    </param>
    <returns>
    The absolute existing managed SDK executable selected for this operation.
    </returns>
    <exception cref="T:System.IO.FileNotFoundException">
    The selected SDK executable is unavailable.
    </exception>
    <exception cref="T:System.PlatformNotSupportedException">
    No standard execution host is registered for this system and processor.
    </exception>
</member>
